title: Tarzan
paragraphs: Original American Gold Seal transcribed Tarzan serial distributed station-by-station.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Tarzan of the Apes adaptation (September 12, 1932 to March 10, 1933) and The Return of Tarzan continuation (March 13, 1933 to March 9, 1934).

The stories often return to survival and physical peril, rescue, capture and escape, ships, sailors, mutiny and shipwreck, wildlife danger and animal encounters, jungle wilderness, and apes and jungle animal society.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Early transcription-disc syndication, Signal Oil sponsorship and radio merchandising, and Print adventure franchise moves to radio.
plain_text:
Original American Gold Seal transcribed Tarzan serial distributed station-by-station.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Tarzan of the Apes adaptation (September 12, 1932 to March 10, 1933) and The Return of Tarzan continuation (March 13, 1933 to March 9, 1934).

The stories often return to survival and physical peril, rescue, capture and escape, ships, sailors, mutiny and shipwreck, wildlife danger and animal encounters, jungle wilderness, and apes and jungle animal society.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Early transcription-disc syndication, Signal Oil sponsorship and radio merchandising, and Print adventure franchise moves to radio.
